instruction: Use GIMP to automatically remove the background from "/home/user/logo.png" using AI-powered subject detection and save it as a new file.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP in the OSWorld environment does not have AI-powered automatic subject detection and background removal features built-in. While manual background removal is possible, fully automatic AI-based detection as implied in the instruction is not available in standard GIMP installations.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly identified as infeasible - GIMP does not have AI-powered automatic background removal built-in
Evaluator appropriately uses the 'infeasible' function for impossible tasks
